title: Live files A4: server routes for delete, rename and new folders (overlay and live path)
description:
Contract: docs/LIVE_FILES_PROTOCOL.md (revision 3) sections 3 (O5, L48 to L66), 6.2, 6.3, 7.8, 12.2, 15 (A4). Gherkin first (features/computer_file_live.feature, tag @server, the group 'delete, rename and new folders').

Delete, rename and new folders are required in Phase 3, also while the computer is off. Any enabled member may delete a file or an empty folder, rename and create folders; only the organization owner role deletes a non-empty folder.

Files:
- conversation/src/http/routes/computer-file-operations.ts (new): DELETE /orgs/:tenant_id/computer/files?path=&recursive= (header If-Match of the effective hash: file content hash, symlink hash, directory tree hash), POST .../files/move (body {from, to}, header If-Match of from), POST .../files/directories (idempotent), GET .../files/overlay (pending changes). Register in conversation/src/http/app.ts (audience user).
- The route decision of 7.3 step 4 (customer-account -> 409 edit_unsupported; live owner able to serve -> live path; protocol 1 -> 409 owner_too_old; sealed and stopping/starting -> 503; otherwise the overlay path using A3's write algebra).
- Role check: Principal.role === 'owner' for recursive; else 403 owner_role_required; a non-recursive delete of a non-empty directory is 409 directory_not_empty; missing If-Match is 428; rename onto an existing path 409 already_exists; into its own subtree 422 invalid_move; workspace root 403 path_refused; over 5000 descendants 413 too_many_entries; .git in path/from/to 403 path_refused (audited); excluded directory names 422 not_in_saved_copy (overlay only).
- conversation/src/domain/live-files.ts: request kinds delete, move, mkdir through the same queue, wait, audit, dirty flag, abandon and outcome_unknown code as write; results mapped to the member codes of 6.3.
- Audit operations delete, move (to_path), mkdir with recursive, removed, tree_sha256_before (7.8.8); rate class write; the idempotent mkdir of an existing directory writes no audit record.
- Steps: conversation/features-support/steps/computer-file-operations.steps.ts.

Scenarios it owns: LF-65 to LF-72 (the @server scenarios of the delete, rename and new folder group).

Acceptance (from conversation/): npm run typecheck; npm test; npm run test:features green; every earlier scenario unchanged.

Dependencies: F0, A2 (shared handlers, live path) and A3 merged. Blocks E.

Rules: no emojis, no line comments, TSDoc on public exports. Do not read or write project/.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Merged to develop in PR 528 (A4), part of Phase 3 (contract PR 519). Proven live on development on 2026-10-13: with the computer off a person can create folders, create a file, rename it and is refused 409 on a stale hash; the next turn on a freshly started computer sees the offline edit (applied at hydrate); with the computer on, read, edit, the bot reads the edit back, delete, then stat is 404; a save with a stale hash after the bot edited is refused 409 and the bot's line survives; If-Match and ETag pass through CloudFront. Not yet proven: the Files panel in a browser at 375 px or with a real signed-in user (chatticus-bf7fd2). Follow-ups: chatticus-5dbb7e, chatticus-f9cfda, chatticus-7c6040, chatticus-d88a0f, chatticus-80b17c, chatticus-e7a52f, chatticus-ed8e4e.
